verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows Featurebase has an API/SDK reference and webhooks, but nothing describes bulk or batch operations across multiple items (e.g., bulk update posts, bulk tagging, batch API calls) that an AI-native user could invoke; the OpenAPI spec probe even returned 404s, giving no visibility into any batch endpoints. Missing for 10: documented batch/bulk API endpoints, bulk action UI features, or SDK methods for operating on many items at once.
